name: PCI DSS
description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard — technical controls

controls.name: Change vendor-supplied defaults
controls.desc: Default credentials and configurations are well-known attack vectors. All defaults must be changed before production use.

controls.name: Strong cryptography for transmission
controls.desc: Cardholder data must be encrypted in transit using strong protocols (TLSv1.2+) and valid certificates.

controls.name: Critical patches within one month
controls.desc: Known vulnerabilities must be patched within 30 days of release to prevent exploitation.

controls.name: Unique IDs and strong authentication
controls.desc: Every user must have a unique ID with strong authentication. Shared root access violates accountability.

controls.name: Strong authentication factors
controls.desc: Authentication factors must be protected with strong cryptography. Password hashes must use a modern algorithm and the shadow file must be root-only.

controls.name: Audit logging implemented
controls.desc: Audit trails for security-relevant events must be active on every system component to support forensics and breach detection.

controls.name: Review security event logs daily
controls.desc: Failed login attempts and suspicious activity must be monitored to detect breaches early.

controls.name: File integrity monitoring
controls.desc: Critical system files must be monitored for unauthorized changes that could indicate compromise.
